defense_weaknesses: Inability to detect all types of hidden logical trojans
recommendations: Improve defense's ability to distinguish between clean and malicious code
Enhance defense's recall/TPR to detect more hidden logical trojans
Develop more effective methods to detect and block trojans
llm_assessment.summary: The defense system demonstrated moderate effectiveness in detecting hidden logical trojans, but struggled with high false positive rates and low recall. The attack system successfully bypassed the defense in 27.4% of cases, indicating a need for improvement in the defense's ability to detect and block trojans.
